registry.description: Hypocrisy is the performance of one thing while being another — the wearing of a face that does not correspond to the actual inner state. The Greek word (hypokrisis) comes from the theatre: an actor playing a role. Jesus's fiercest language in the Gospels is directed at hypocrites, those who perform righteousness for human approval while remaining inwardly unchanged. Hypocrisy is particularly destructive because it corrupts the very forms of religion that are supposed to lead toward God.
